newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Kwantas debuts at 5.80 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Kwantas debuts at 5.80 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's Kwantas Corp Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday at 5.80 ringgit, versus a 2.95 ringgit offer price.
The oil palm concern offered 10 million shares. At 0139 GMT, the stock was trading at 5.45 ringgit.
Kwantas is involved in operating oil palm plantations, a palm oil mill, a kernel crushing plant and palm oil refining. It also operates a stone and gravel quarry.

For the year ending June 30, 1997, it has forecast a net profit of 22.52 million ringgit or 29.87 cents a share. In the previous year, it posted net profit of 18.0 million ringgit or 22.48 cents a share on turnover of 91.40 million ringgit.
HLG Securities, in a report issued this week, said it estimated fair value for Kwantas at 5.50 ringgit a share.

It said Kwantas is expected to focus its activities on refining to boost earnings. "With full utilisation of the refinery in fiscal 1997 and 1998, pretax earnings are projected to rise by more than 40 percent, the report said.
On a pretax basis, Kwantas reported earnings of 23.13 million ringgit in the year ended June 30, 1996.
